page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized bare-metal virtualized server designed for GPU-accelerated workloads. The instance is powered by 128 dedicated vCPUs and configured with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing 6.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by four NVIDIA A10 GPUs, delivering a combined 96 GB of GDDR6 VRAM with 24 GB per card.

Network connectivity features a high-throughput baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating rapid data transfers between distributed training or rendering clusters. The server does not bundle any local ephemeral or NVMe storage, meaning all persistence and operating systems must be provisioned via external cloud storage solutions. It also includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating network configuration through VPC gateways or Elastic IPs for direct internet accessibility.

Resource allocation couples high CPU core counts with dense GPU acceleration, offering a balanced profile for concurrent graphics pipelines and AI tasks without requiring top-tier training accelerators. The architecture is suited for multi-stream AI inference, 3D graphics rendering, video transcode pipelines, cloud gaming, and general compute-intensive simulations.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is a dedicated GPU-accelerated compute instance featuring 128 x86_64 vCPUs and 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding 6.0 GB of RAM per core. Hardware acceleration is driven by four NVIDIA A10 GPUs providing a collective 96 GB of VRAM. Operating under the KVM hypervisor, the server provides 64 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth to handle large-scale data transfers and cluster synchronization. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, requiring external cloud block storage for file systems and data persistence. Additionally, zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default. Given its dense GPU configuration and substantial memory footprint, this instance serves intensive workloads such as multi-stream artificial intelligence inference, professional graphic rendering, video processing, and distributed simulation environments.
